children: is approaching its fiscal third-quarter results with investors focused on whether its AI business can maintain its recent growth pace.

The chipmaker is expected to post adjusted earnings of $3.24 per share on revenue of $29.36 billion. Broadcom's second-quarter AI semiconductor sales reached $10.8 billion, while total revenue came in at $22.19 billion.
Management has projected third-quarter revenue of about $29.4 billion and AI semiconductor sales of $16 billion. That would represent more than 200% year-over-year growth for the AI segment.

Demand visibility has also increased, with AI-related bookings exceeding $30 billion during the second quarter. Broadcom has expanded its AI efforts through work with OpenAI on a custom accelerator and a multiyear chip agreement with Apple worth more than $30 billion.
Shares have faced some pressure ahead of the report as investors assess valuation and customer concentration. Wall Street has a Strong Buy consensus, while Seeking Alpha's Quant rating is Hold.
For AVGO stock, the earnings report could show whether AI demand is translating into sustained revenue growth despite valuation concerns.

title: Broadcom Stock Faces an Earnings Test -- AI Sales Are Set to Soar
